newsitem.title: USA: Credit Management sees Q1 loss as expected.
newsitem.headline: Credit Management sees Q1 loss as expected.

text.p: Credit Management Solutions Inc, a developer of credit analysis software, said preliminary first quarter results showed revenue of about $3.8 million and a net loss of $300,000.
"First quarter net results showed a loss approximating $300,000 as anticipated," said Chief Executive James DeFrancesco.
The company, which had its IPO in December, gave no year ago figures nor a date for its detailed results.
The company said it was making good progress in its Credit Connection product with auto dealers.

It also announced that the credit finance arm of Japan's Nissan Motor Co Ltd had signed a letter of intent to make Credit Connection available to its 1,100 dealers nationwide in the U.S. ((-- New York Newsrom 212 859 1610))
